_comment: INPUTS OUT FOR HARDWARE REASONS: a health mask the generator reads at every regeneration.
Indices are on the correlator/bffs input axis, pol*64 + dish, the same axis as the GNSS
element axis (chord_array_epochs.json cube_order). The generator takes the union of these
and bffs's flagged inputs out of the GNSS branch's static element lists (projection
stations, channel-noise inputs, shared-reference entries). It does not touch the node's
updatable_config/bad_inputs, the science N2 mask, which bffs and choco own.
A dark or removed input goes here, not into a new array epoch. gnss_arraymap.py check
requires every masked input to be in the open epoch's cube_order and every element that
epoch marks `removed` to be masked. `since` is a record, not evaluated against the clock.

entries.why: F-engine board carrying row H's Y pol removed (KV 2026-10-25)
